reviewNote: Draft content written from published red-flag guidance. Must be reviewed and signed off by a licensed clinician (plan D6) before real-world use.

projectile.label: Forceful vomiting
projectile.help:
Vomit that shoots out far.
In young babies it can mean a blocked stomach outlet.

pillows.label: Pillows needed to sleep
pillows.help:
Pillows you stack to breathe easier.
Needing more pillows can mean fluid in the lungs.

armJaw.label: Spreads to arm, jaw or back

newMedicine.label: Started a new medicine
newMedicine.help:
A new tablet, syrup or injection.
Many medicines cause this.

chestFaint.label: Fainted or nearly fainted
chestFaint.help:
Passing out, or feeling you would.
Fainting with chest or heart signs can mean danger.

chestSick.label: Feel sick or vomited
chestSick.help:
Feeling sick or throwing up with the pain.
Some heart attacks show as sickness.

painMinutes.label: Pain so far, in minutes
painMinutes.help:
How long the pain has gone on until now.
Pain past 15 minutes needs urgent care.

worseBreathing.label: Worse when you breathe in or cough
worseBreathing.help:
The pain changes with each breath.
This helps tell lung pain from heart pain.

palpMinutes.label: Minutes it has lasted
palpMinutes.help:
How long this spell has gone on.
Long spells need a heart check.

palpRegular.label: Beat steady or uneven
palpRegular.help:
Steady means evenly spaced beats.
An uneven beat needs a heart check.

pulseRate.label: Pulse, if counted
pulseRate.help:
Beats in one minute, felt at the wrist.
A very fast pulse needs care.

palpChest.label: Chest pain with it
palpChest.help:
Pain or tightness in the chest during the spell.
Chest pain with a racing heart is urgent.

palpFaint.label: Faint or dizzy with it
palpFaint.help:
Light-headed, or about to pass out.
It can mean the heart is not pumping well.

breathTalk.label: Out of breath when talking
breathTalk.help:
You cannot finish a sentence without a gasp.
It shows how severe the breathing trouble is.

blueLips.label: Lips or face blue
blueLips.help:
Blue or grey colour.
Not enough air is getting in.

breathChest.label: Chest pain when breathing in
breathChest.help:
A sharp pain with each deep breath.
It can point to a lung clot or lung problem.

oxygenBand.label: Oxygen reading
oxygenBand.help:
The number on a finger oxygen meter.
Low readings need care the same day.

usesInhaler.label: Uses a puffer
usesInhaler.help:
A breathing inhaler.
Tells us if this has happened before.

inhalerNoHelp.label: Puffer not helping
inhalerNoHelp.help:
The puffer gave little or no relief.
A puffer that fails is an emergency sign.

bloodAmount.label: How much blood
bloodAmount.help:
A rough amount of blood coughed up.
More blood means more danger.

coughFever.label: Fever with it
coughFever.help:
Feeling hot, or a high temperature.
Fever with blood in cough needs a doctor.

weightLossLately.label: Lost weight without trying
weightLossLately.help:
Weight fell, and you did not diet.
This can be a warning sign.

weightUp.label: Weight up fast
weightUp.help:
Weight went up quickly, over days.
It can mean the body is holding water.

swellDays.label: Days swollen
swellDays.help:
How long the swelling has been there.
New swelling is checked sooner.

legPainful.label: Calf painful
legPainful.help:
Pain or tenderness in the calf.
One painful swollen leg needs a same-day check.

snoreLoud.label: Loud snoring
snoreLoud.help:
Loud enough for others to hear.
Loud snoring with pauses is a warning sign.

apneaWitnessed.label: Seen to stop breathing
apneaWitnessed.help:
Someone saw pauses in your breathing.
Pauses strain the heart and brain.

wakeGasping.label: Wake up gasping
wakeGasping.help:
Waking suddenly short of breath.
It shows the breathing stops at night.

daySleepy.label: Very sleepy in the day
daySleepy.help:
You doze off when sitting or reading.
Daytime sleep raises the risk of accidents.

bpToldHigh.label: Told BP is high
bpToldHigh.help:
A doctor said your pressure is high.
Night breathing problems and BP go together.

snoreDrive.label: Nodding off while driving
snoreDrive.help:
You doze at the wheel or in traffic.
This is a road safety danger.

nightChest.label: Chest pain or racing heart at night
nightChest.help:
Chest pain or fast beats that wake you.
It can mean the heart is strained.

sysBp.label: Top BP number
sysBp.help:
The first, larger number of a BP reading.
Very high numbers need same-day care.

diaBp.label: Bottom BP number
diaBp.help:
The second, smaller number of a BP reading.
A very high bottom number also needs care.

onBpTablets.label: Takes BP tablets
onBpTablets.help:
Daily tablets for blood pressure.
Missed tablets often explain high readings.

missedBpTablets.label: Missed BP tablets
missedBpTablets.help:
Skipped or forgotten doses.
It may be the simple cause.

strokeSigns.label: Face droop, weak limb or slurred speech
strokeSigns.help:
Any sudden weakness of face, limb or speech.
These can be signs of a stroke.

bpChest.label: Chest pain
bpChest.help:
Pain or pressure in the chest.
Chest pain with BP trouble is urgent.

lowBpBand.label: Top BP number band
lowBpBand.help:
The first number of your BP reading.
Below 90 is low and needs care.

lowFluidLoss.label: Vomiting, loose motions or poor drinking
lowFluidLoss.help:
Losing or not taking in enough fluid.
Dry body is a common cause of low BP.

faintWeak.label: Faint, dizzy or very weak
faintWeak.help:
Light-headed, unsteady or drained.
It can mean blood loss or low BP.

bellyBlood.label: Vomited blood or black stool
bellyBlood.help:
Blood from the mouth, or tar-like stool.
This means bleeding inside the gut.

hoursPain.label: Hours so far
hoursPain.help:
How long the pain has gone on.
Pain that lasts hours needs a doctor.

bellyWhere.label: Where in the belly
bellyWhere.help:
The spot that hurts most.
The spot helps the doctor judge the cause.

bellyHard.label: Belly hard or very sore
bellyHard.help:
The belly is stiff, or hurts on a light touch.
It can mean a serious problem inside.

noWind.label: Cannot pass wind or stool
noWind.help:
Nothing is coming out, not even wind.
It can mean the gut is blocked.

bellyBloat.label: Belly swollen
bellyBloat.help:
The belly looks or feels bigger than usual.
Swelling with a blocked gut is urgent.

vomitWith.label: Vomiting with it
vomitWith.help:
Throwing up along with the problem.
Vomiting with other signs can mean a block.

daysSoFar.label: Days so far
daysSoFar.help:
How long since it started.
Longer illness needs a check.

cantKeepFluids.label: Cannot keep drinks down
cantKeepFluids.help:
You bring up nearly everything you drink.
The body can dry out fast.

noUrine8h.label: No urine for 8 hours
noUrine8h.help:
No urine at all in the last 8 hours.
The kidneys may be in trouble.

headNeck.label: Bad headache, stiff neck or confusion
headNeck.help:
A very bad headache, neck too stiff to bend, or muddled thinking.
Sickness with these can be a brain danger.

nauseaChest.label: Chest pain or tightness
nauseaChest.help:
Pain or pressure in the chest.
Feeling sick can be a heart sign.

vomitGreen.label: Green vomit
vomitGreen.help:
Bright green or yellow-green fluid.
It can mean the gut is blocked.

vomitBloodAmount.label: How much blood
vomitBloodAmount.help:
A rough amount of blood in the vomit.
More blood means more danger.

takesPainkillers.label: Takes aspirin or painkiller tablets
takesPainkillers.help:
Tablets such as aspirin or ibuprofen.
They can hurt the stomach lining.

daysNoStool.label: Days since last stool
daysNoStool.help:
Days since the last proper stool.
More than a week needs a check.

bowelChange.label: Change in toilet habits
bowelChange.help:
Loose or hard stools that are new for you.
New bowel change needs a check.

stoolBloodColour.label: Colour of blood
stoolBloodColour.help:
The colour of blood in your stool.
Dark blood comes from higher up in the gut.

stoolBloodAmount.label: How much blood
stoolBloodAmount.help:
A rough amount of blood.
More blood means more danger.

vomitBloodToo.label: Vomited blood too
vomitBloodToo.help:
Blood or dark fluid coming up.
It means bleeding higher up in the gut.

flankPain.label: Pain in the side or back
flankPain.help:
Pain below the ribs, to one side.
It can mean a kidney problem.

rigors.label: Shaking chills
rigors.help:
Shivering you cannot stop.
It can mean infection in the blood.

urinePerDay.label: Times passing urine in a day
urinePerDay.help:
Number of times in 24 hours.
It helps judge how bad this is.

nightTimes.label: Times at night
nightTimes.help:
Trips to the toilet at night.
Many night trips need a check.

veryThirsty.label: Very thirsty
veryThirsty.help:
Thirst or passing lots of urine.
High sugar dries the mouth.

noEmpty.label: Bladder never feels empty
noEmpty.help:
You still feel full after passing urine.
It can mean the bladder is not emptying.

bladderPain.label: Lower belly pain or full feeling
bladderPain.help:
Pain or tightness low in the belly.
It means the bladder may be full.

dropsOnly.label: Only drops coming
dropsOnly.help:
A weak dribble, not a stream.
It can mean the flow is blocked.

saddleNumb.label: Numb between legs
saddleNumb.help:
Loss of feeling in the groin and bottom.
The spinal nerves may be squeezed.

urineBloodColour.label: Colour of urine
urineBloodColour.help:
The colour of the urine with blood.
Clots and bright red mean more danger.

leakWhen.label: When it leaks
leakWhen.help:
What brings on the leak.
The pattern helps find the cause.

bowelLeak.label: Stool leaking too
bowelLeak.help:
Stool comes out without warning.
With urine leak it can mean nerve trouble.

painWaves.label: Pain comes in waves
painWaves.help:
It rises, eases, then rises again.
Wave pain can mean a stone.

urineBloodSeen.label: Blood in urine
urineBloodSeen.help:
Red or pink urine.
It helps find a kidney or bladder cause.

swollenLegsToo.label: Legs swollen too
swollenLegsToo.help:
Swelling of feet or ankles.
Face and leg swelling can mean kidney or heart trouble.

foamyUrine.label: Foamy urine
foamyUrine.help:
Lots of froth that stays.
Froth can mean protein leaking.

lessUrine.label: Passing much less urine
lessUrine.help:
Clearly less than your usual amount.
The kidneys may not be working well.

periodPainNew.label: New or much worse than usual
periodPainNew.help:
Not your usual period pain.
New pain needs a check.

periodLate.label: Period is late
periodLate.help:
More than a week past the due date.
A late period changes what the pain could be.

maybePregnant.label: Could be pregnant
maybePregnant.help:
You might be pregnant.
Pregnancy changes how urgent this is.

padsHour.label: Soaking a pad every hour
padsHour.help:
A full pad each hour for 2 hours or more.
This is dangerous blood loss.

bleedDays.label: Days of bleeding
bleedDays.help:
Days since the bleeding began.
Bleeding past 7 days needs a check.

bigClots.label: Big clots
bigClots.help:
Clots bigger than a one rupee coin.
Big clots show heavy bleeding.

monthsSincePeriod.label: Months since last period
monthsSincePeriod.help:
Months without a period.
A year or more means periods have stopped.

bleedAmount.label: How much bleeding
bleedAmount.help:
A rough amount of bleeding.
Heavier bleeding needs faster care.

onHrt.label: On hormone tablets or patches
onHrt.help:
Hormones for menopause.
They can cause some bleeding.

pelvicPain.label: Pain low in the belly
pelvicPain.help:
Pain below the belly button.
It can mean infection or another cause.

dischargeColour.label: Colour of discharge
dischargeColour.help:
The colour you see.
Colour helps tell the cause.

fishySmell.label: Fishy smell
fishySmell.help:
A strong, fish-like smell.
Smell helps tell the cause.

riskSex.label: New partner or unprotected sex
riskSex.help:
Sex without a condom, or with someone new.
It tells if an infection test is needed.

lumpGrowing.label: Lump getting bigger
lumpGrowing.help:
It is larger than when you first saw it.
Growing lumps need a check.

lumpHard.label: Lump is hard
lumpHard.help:
It feels like a stone stuck under the skin.
Hard, fixed lumps need a check.

skinChange.label: Skin dimpled or like orange peel
skinChange.help:
Puckered or pitted breast skin.
It is a warning sign.

nippleChange.label: Nipple turned in or leaking
nippleChange.help:
A new nipple change or a bloody leak.
It is a warning sign.

armpitLump.label: Lump in the armpit
armpitLump.help:
A swelling under the arm.
It may need testing.

painCyclic.label: Worse before period
painCyclic.help:
Pain rises in the week before a period.
This pattern is usually harmless.

breastLump.label: Felt a lump
breastLump.help:
A hard spot in the breast.
A lump needs a doctor within 2 weeks.

breastfeeding.label: Breastfeeding
breastfeeding.help:
Feeding a baby with breast milk.
Feeding can cause a blocked or infected breast.

flushPerDay.label: Flushes in a day
flushPerDay.help:
Count of hot spells in 24 hours.
It tells how much this affects you.

periodsChanged.label: Periods stopped or changed
periodsChanged.help:
Late, missed or different periods.
It fits the change of life.

nightSoaking.label: Soaking night sweats
nightSoaking.help:
Night sweat that wets clothes or sheets.
Soaking sweats can have other causes.

racingHeart.label: Racing heart
racingHeart.help:
Fast or pounding beats.
A racing heart with heat can be another cause.

bleedAfterStop.label: Bleeding after periods stopped
bleedAfterStop.help:
Blood from the vagina after menopause.
It always needs a check.

bloatDaily.label: Bloated most days
bloatDaily.help:
Bloating on most days of the month.
Daily bloating that lasts needs a check.

earlySatiety.label: Full after a few bites
earlySatiety.help:
You cannot finish a normal meal.
It can be an early warning sign.

bellySwollenFast.label: Belly swelling fast
bellySwollenFast.help:
It grows over days or weeks.
Fast swelling needs a check.

foodSticks.label: Food sticks
foodSticks.help:
Food seems to stop in the chest or throat.
It needs a check within days.

chokeCough.label: Choke or cough when eating
chokeCough.help:
Food or drink goes down the wrong way.
Food in the lungs can cause a chest infection.

regurgitate.label: Food comes back up
regurgitate.help:
Whole food returns to the mouth.
It can mean food is held up.

swallowWhat.label: What is hard to swallow
swallowWhat.help:
The food that gives trouble.
It shows how bad the block is.

droolSaliva.label: Cannot swallow spit
droolSaliva.help:
Spit pools or drools out.
It means a full block. It is an emergency.

foodStuckNow.label: Food stuck now
foodStuckNow.help:
Food is stuck and will not go down.
A stuck lump can block breathing.

hiccupHours.label: Hours of hiccups
hiccupHours.help:
Hours since they began.
Hiccups over 48 hours need a check.

darkUrine.label: Dark urine
darkUrine.help:
Urine looks dark yellow or brown.
Dark urine shows the body is short of water.

paleStool.label: Pale stool
paleStool.help:
Stool lost its brown colour.
It means bile may be blocked.

upperRightPain.label: Pain in upper right belly
upperRightPain.help:
Pain under the right ribs.
It can mean a bile duct problem.

tooManyTablets.label: Took too much paracetamol
tooManyTablets.help:
More tablets than the pack says.
Too much harms the liver, even if you feel fine.

howLong.label: How long
howLong.help:
How many days or weeks you have had this.
Short and long problems need different care.

diabetes.label: Has diabetes
diabetes.help:
A sugar problem that needs tablets or insulin.
Healing and infection risk are higher.

tooWeak.label: Too weak to stand
tooWeak.help:
You cannot get up or stand on your own.
Being this weak can mean a serious illness.

feverRash.label: Rash that does not fade
feverRash.help:
Press a clear glass on the rash. It stays red or purple.
This can be a sign of a serious infection.

lowImmunity.label: Weak body defence
lowImmunity.help:
Medicines that lower the body's defence against germs.
Infections can turn serious faster then.

chestDiscomfort.label: Chest pain or pressure
chestDiscomfort.help:
A tight, heavy or aching feeling in the chest.
It can be a sign of a heart problem.

unplannedWeightLoss.label: Losing weight without trying
unplannedWeightLoss.help:
Your weight is dropping and you are not dieting.
This needs a check even if you feel well.

lowInterest.label: Little interest or joy
lowInterest.help:
Not enjoying things you used to like.
Low mood can hide behind tiredness.

weakOneSide.label: Weak or numb on one side
weakOneSide.help:
An arm, leg or the face feels weak or numb on one side.
This can be a sign of a stroke.

spreadingUp.label: Weakness creeping up from feet
spreadingUp.help:
Weakness starts in the toes and climbs to the legs.
This pattern needs a doctor quickly.

cantSwallowWater.label: Hard to swallow water
cantSwallowWater.help:
Water will not go down, or makes you choke.
You may get dry or not get enough medicine.

yellowSkin.label: Skin or eyes yellow
yellowSkin.help:
Yellow tint to skin or eye whites.
This can mean a liver problem.

bellyPain.label: Belly pain
bellyPain.help:
Pain anywhere between the ribs and the hips.
Belly pain changes what we check.

peeingMore.label: Passing more urine than usual
peeingMore.help:
You go to the toilet far more often to pass urine.
It can go with high sugar or dryness.

nightSweatsAlso.label: Drenching night sweats
nightSweatsAlso.help:
Sweat that soaks your clothes or sheets.
It can go with infection or other illness.

longCough.label: Cough over 3 weeks
longCough.help:
A cough that has not gone away in 3 weeks.
A long cough needs a chest check.

swallowHard.label: Food sticks when swallowing
swallowHard.help:
Food feels stuck in the throat or chest.
It can mean a blockage.

onPurpose.label: Trying to lose weight
onPurpose.help:
You are dieting or exercising to lose weight.
If yes, we ask fewer questions.

weightLostKg.label: Weight lost (kg)
weightLostKg.help:
Kilograms lost, as best you know.
A big drop is more worrying.

nightsPerWeek.label: Nights per week
nightsPerWeek.help:
Count the nights in a usual week.
Often is more worrying than rare.

lumpNeckArmpit.label: Lumps in neck or armpit
lumpNeckArmpit.help:
Small hard swellings under the skin there.
Glands swell with infection and other illness.

sugarBand.label: Sugar reading
sugarBand.help:
Pick the band for your meter reading in mg/dL.
Low and high sugar both need quick action.

takesSugarMedicine.label: Takes insulin or sugar tablets
takesSugarMedicine.help:
Medicine that lowers blood sugar.
These can cause low sugar.

vomitOrLoose.label: Vomiting or loose stools
vomitOrLoose.help:
Being sick or passing watery stools.
These can dry out the body.

dizzyOnStanding.label: Dizzy when standing up
dizzyOnStanding.help:
The head spins or goes light on standing.
It can show low water or low blood pressure.

onWaterPills.label: Takes water tablets
onWaterPills.help:
Tablets that make you pass more urine.
They can dry the body out.

selfHarmPlan.label: Has thought how
selfHarmPlan.help:
Thinking of a way or a time.
It helps us see how urgent help is.

selfHarmNow.label: Feels unsafe now
selfHarmNow.help:
Worried you may act on these thoughts soon.
If yes, we will point you to help now.

selfHarmActed.label: Hurt self today
selfHarmActed.help:
Any harm to yourself or extra medicine, today.
Quick medical care may be needed.

notAlone.label: Someone is with them
notAlone.help:
A person is near you at this moment.
Being with someone makes you safer.

fastHeart.label: Racing heart
fastHeart.help:
You feel fast or pounding beats.
It can come from worry or a heart problem.

sleepTrouble.label: Sleep problem
sleepTrouble.help:
Falling asleep, waking at night, or waking early.
Each type has a different cause.

wakesBreathless.label: Wakes up breathless
wakesBreathless.help:
You wake suddenly and gasp for air.
It can be a heart or lung problem.

snoring.label: Loud snoring or stops breathing
snoring.help:
Others hear loud snoring or pauses in breath.
It can ruin sleep and tire you.

hardToWake.label: Hard to wake
hardToWake.help:
Sleepy, or slow to open eyes.
It can mean a serious illness.

recentLoss.label: Recent loss
recentLoss.help:
A death or a big loss in recent months.
Loss can bring low mood and loneliness.

noOneToTalk.label: No one to talk to
noOneToTalk.help:
No friend or family you can call.
Having someone to talk to protects health.

unsafeAtHome.label: Feels unsafe at home
unsafeAtHome.help:
Someone shouts at you, hurts you or takes your money.
We ask so you can get safe help.

hallucType.label: What they sense
hallucType.help:
Seeing things, hearing voices, or both.
The type helps us judge the cause.

voicesHarm.label: Voices say to hurt
voicesHarm.help:
Voices that give orders to harm you or others.
This needs help right away.

stoppedAlcohol.label: Stopped alcohol lately
stoppedAlcohol.help:
Heavy drinkers who stop can become unwell.
Stopping suddenly can be dangerous.

shaky.label: Shaky or very hungry
shaky.help:
Trembling hands or a sudden strong hunger.
These are early signs of low sugar.

skippedMeal.label: Missed meal or extra medicine
skippedMeal.help:
Not eating, or more tablets or insulin than usual.
It is a common cause of low sugar.

footSore.label: Sore or wound on foot
footSore.help:
Broken skin, a blister or a cut on the foot.
Foot wounds heal badly with numbness.

footColdPale.label: Foot cold, pale or blue
footColdPale.help:
One foot looks whiter or bluer than the other.
The blood flow may be blocked.

lumpWhere.label: Where is the lump
lumpWhere.help:
Pick the place that fits best.
The place changes who should see it.

lumpRedHot.label: Lump red, hot or leaking
lumpRedHot.help:
The skin over it is red and warm.
It may be infected.

cannotPushBack.label: Painful and will not go back
cannotPushBack.help:
A groin or belly lump that hurts and will not push in.
The gut may be trapped.

heavyPeriods.label: Heavy periods or bleeding
heavyPeriods.help:
Soaking pads fast, or passing clots.
Blood loss can make you pale.

whenAfterMedicine.label: When it began
whenAfterMedicine.help:
Pick the time between the tablet and the problem.
Quick onset can mean a strong reaction.

throatTight.label: Throat tight, hoarse or noisy breathing
throatTight.help:
Tight throat, odd voice or noisy breath.
The airway may be closing.

rashHives.label: Itchy rash or hives
rashHives.help:
Red, raised, itchy patches on the skin.
A rash can be a reaction to medicine.

skinPeeling.label: Blisters or peeling skin
skinPeeling.help:
Skin lifting off, or painful sores in mouth or eyes.
This can be a severe medicine reaction.

unusualBleeding.label: Unusual bleeding or bruising
unusualBleeding.help:
Gums, nose or skin bleed or bruise easily.
Some medicines make bleeding more likely.

legSwollen.label: One leg swollen or sore
legSwollen.help:
One calf is bigger or hurts more than the other.
It can be a blood clot.

fellRecently.label: Fell in the past month
fellRecently.help:
Any fall, even without injury.
Falls show a higher risk of a bad fall.

coughsChokes.label: Coughs or chokes when eating
coughsChokes.help:
Coughing during or just after a swallow.
Food may go down the wrong way.

mouthSore.label: Sore mouth or teeth
mouthSore.help:
Pain or trouble when chewing.
Mouth problems are easy to fix.

painSwallowing.label: Pain when swallowing
painSwallowing.help:
A sharp or burning pain as food goes down.
Pain can point to a throat or food pipe problem.

whichAccident.label: What leaked
whichAccident.help:
Urine, stool, or both.
The type helps us find the cause.

burnsPeeing.label: Burning when passing urine
burnsPeeing.help:
A stinging or burning pain when urine passes.
It can mean a urine infection.

painWhere.label: Where is the pain
painWhere.help:
Pick the main place.
The place tells us what to check.

cancerHistory.label: Had cancer before
cancerHistory.help:
A past cancer, even if treated.
Old cancers can come back as night pain.

hasDiabetes.label: Has diabetes
hasDiabetes.help:
Whether the person has diabetes.
Sugar problems can cause this symptom.

headKnockWeeks.label: Head knock in the past weeks
headKnockWeeks.help:
A bump to the head, even a small one.
Slow bleeding can follow a small knock.

notDrinking.label: Drinking much less
notDrinking.help:
Drinking far fewer fluids than normal.
Being dry can cause this, more so when older.

heartSigns.label: Chest pain or racing heart
heartSigns.help:
Pain in the chest or a heart that races.
The heart can be the cause.

bleedSigns.label: Black stool or blood in vomit
bleedSigns.help:
Stool like tar, or blood when being sick.
Hidden bleeding can cause this.

notRecovered.label: Not back to normal
notRecovered.help:
Still muddled or drowsy after the event.
It should clear in minutes; if not, it needs urgent care.

settledAlready.label: Symptom already gone
settledAlready.help:
The problem came and went.
Symptoms that clear can still be a warning.

breathTrouble.label: Hard or noisy breathing
breathTrouble.help:
Struggling for air or a noisy, high sound.
The airway may be narrowing.

swellingLipsThroat.label: Lip, tongue or throat swelling
swellingLipsThroat.help:
Swelling of the mouth or throat.
This can close the airway fast.

scalpJawPain.label: Scalp tender or jaw pain when chewing
scalpJawPain.help:
Sore scalp when touched, or jaw ache while eating.
In people over 50, this can harm sight if missed.

mouthOpen.label: Can open mouth fully

neckLump.label: New neck lump

swallowHurts.label: Pain or trouble swallowing

usesTobacco.label: Smoke or chew tobacco

afterHeadKnock.label: After a head knock

hearingDrop.label: Hearing worse

earFluid.label: Fluid from ear

Wet or sticky fluid from the ear.

noseBloodStained.label: Blood-stained nose fluid

Pink or red streaks in nose fluid.

clearFluidAfterKnock.label: Clear watery fluid after knock
clearFluidAfterKnock.help:
Thin fluid like water from nose or ear.

eyelidSwollen.label: Swollen red eyelid
eyelidSwollen.help:
Puffy, red skin around the eye.

faceSinusPain.label: Pain in cheeks or forehead

Ache over the sinuses.

otherBleeding.label: Bleeding gums, nose, urine or stool

Blood from anywhere else.

feelFaint.label: Faint or dizzy from blood loss
feelFaint.help:
Light-headed, like you may pass out.

eyeInjury.label: Eye injury or chemical

A blow, a chip, or a liquid in the eye.

redEye.label: Red eye

The white of the eye looks red.

lightHurts.label: Light hurts
lightHurts.help:
Light makes the eye sore.

eyeHalos.label: Rainbow rings round lights
eyeHalos.help:
Coloured rings around bright lights.

sickWithEye.label: Sick or headache with eye pain
sickWithEye.help:
Nausea, vomiting or head pain with the eye.

contactLens.label: Wears contact lenses
contactLens.help:
Lenses worn on the eyes.

rashForehead.label: Rash on forehead or eyelid
rashForehead.help:
Small blisters on one side of the face.

eyeDischarge.label: Sticky discharge
eyeDischarge.help:
Thick gunk that glues the lids.

curtainShadow.label: Dark curtain or shadow
curtainShadow.help:
A dark patch that blocks part of the view.

itchySneeze.label: Itchy eyes or sneezing

Itch in the eyes, nose or throat.

flashesLight.label: Flashes of light
flashesLight.help:
Sparks or lightning streaks in the sight.
It can mean the retina is pulling.

lastWell.label: Time last well
lastWell.help:
The last time everything felt normal.

balanceLost.label: Sudden loss of balance
balanceLost.help:
Stumbling or swaying with no warning.

bladderBowelChange.label: Bladder or bowel change
bladderBowelChange.help:
New leaking or not being able to go.

legsWeakening.label: Weakness spreading up legs
legsWeakening.help:
Weakness that gets worse over hours or days.

urineBurning.label: Burning when passing urine
urineBurning.help:
Stinging or pain passing water.
Urine infection often confuses older people.

bleedMinutes.label: Minutes bleeding
bleedMinutes.help:
The time the bleeding has gone on.

bleedsOften.label: Bleeds often
bleedsOften.help:
Repeated bleeds over weeks.

highBpKnown.label: High blood pressure
highBpKnown.help:
A known diagnosis of high pressure.

sickManyTimes.label: Sick many times
sickManyTimes.help:
Vomiting again and again.
Being dry needs care.

painkillerDays.label: Painkillers many days
painkillerDays.help:
Tablets for pain most days.

migraineUsual.label: Like usual migraine
migraineUsual.help:
The same as attacks you know.
A new kind of headache needs a check.

dizzyLasts.label: How long each spell
dizzyLasts.help:
The length of one spell of dizziness.

dizzyHeadache.label: Sudden headache or neck pain with it

faintCardiac.label: During effort, or chest pain or racing heart
faintCardiac.help:
Fainting while active, or with heart symptoms.

firstEverFit.label: First ever fit

No fits before today.

fitLong.label: Fit over 5 minutes

Shaking for longer than 5 minutes.

fitRepeat.label: Fits came again

More than one fit close together.

earPainRash.label: Ear pain or rash
earPainRash.help:
Pain or blisters around the ear.

speechType.label: What is wrong with speech

weakWhere.label: Where weak

numbWhere.label: Where numb

The part of the body that is numb.

tinglingWhere.label: Where tingling

The part of the body that tingles.
The place helps the doctor find the cause.

lowB12Diet.label: Vegetarian or long-term metformin

A diet or medicine that can lower vitamin B12.

memoryCourse.label: How memory changed

Sudden, slow, or on and off.

repeatsQuestions.label: Repeats questions

Asking again and again within minutes.

gotLost.label: Got lost

Losing the way in a familiar place.
It is a common early sign.

dailyTasksHarder.label: Daily tasks harder
dailyTasksHarder.help:
Everyday jobs that were easy are now hard.

moodLow.label: Low mood
moodLow.help:
Sad most days.

tremorWhen.label: When it shakes
tremorWhen.help:
At rest, or when using the hands.

slowStiff.label: Slow or stiff
slowStiff.help:
Slow movement or stiff limbs.

heartRacingSweat.label: Heart racing, sweating, weight loss
heartRacingSweat.help:
Fast heart, sweats, thinner.

alcoholCut.label: Cut down alcohol

Heavy drinking, then stopping.

feetNumb.label: Numb feet
feetNumb.help:
Loss of feeling in the feet.

headacheWithBalance.label: New headache with it
headacheWithBalance.help:
A fresh headache or being sick.

earDischargeColour.label: Discharge colour
earDischargeColour.help:
The look of the fluid from the ear.

swollenBehindEar.label: Swollen behind ear

Puffy, red or tender skin behind the ear.

hasRinging.label: Ringing in that ear

pulseTinnitus.label: Ringing beats with heart

A whooshing that matches your pulse.

tinnitusDistress.label: Upsets sleep or mood

earBlocked.label: Ear feels blocked

lowImmune.label: Low immunity

Treatment that weakens the body's defence.

bloodInSpit.label: Blood in spit

Streaks or spots of blood.

lostWeight.label: Lost weight

Clothes are looser, no diet.

afterColdOrShouting.label: After cold or heavy voice use

doubleWorse.label: Better then worse

A second dip after first easing.

sprayOverWeek.label: Nose spray over a week

Decongestant spray most days.

afterNoseKnock.label: After knock to nose

A blow to the nose.

afterNewTrigger.label: After new food, sting or medicine

A new thing eaten, stung or taken.

sneezeTrigger.label: What sets it off
sneezeTrigger.help:
The thing that brings on sneezing.

smellOrTaste.label: Smell or taste
smellOrTaste.help:
Which sense is affected.

noseBlockedNow.label: Nose blocked

appetiteLow.label: Not eating

lumpInnerCorner.label: Red lump near nose corner

cannotCloseEye.label: Cannot close eye

The lid will not shut.

thirstPee.label: Very thirsty, passing lots of urine

Drinking and peeing far more than usual.

doubleGoesOneClosed.label: Goes away closing one eye

Seeing two goes to one with an eye shut.

eyelidDroop.label: Drooping eyelid
eyelidDroop.help:
A lid that sags, or unequal pupils.

worseEvening.label: Worse late in the day

It gets worse through the day.

dryMouthToo.label: Dry mouth too

Dry eyes and a dry mouth together.

shortSighted.label: Very short-sighted or eye surgery

Strong glasses or past eye operation.

manyFloaters.label: Shower of new spots

Many new specks at once.

toothChest.label: Pain with effort or chest tightness
toothChest.help:

faceSwollen.label: Face or jaw swollen

Swelling of the cheek or jaw.

painWakes.label: Wakes at night or lingers

Pain at night or lasting after a drink.

bleedOnlyBrushing.label: Bleeds only when brushing

bleedSpont.label: Bleeds without brushing

Bleeding with no touch.

tiredPale.label: Tired and pale

gumPus.label: Gum swollen with pus

A sore lump on the gum.

ulcerNumber.label: Number of ulcers

ulcerHard.label: Hard, red or white patch or lump

A firm lump or a patch that stays.

painStopsDrinking.label: Too sore to drink

Pain stops you taking fluids.

dentureLoose.label: Dentures loose or rub

Dentures that move or rub the gum.

sorePatch.label: Raw patch on gum

whitePatch.label: White patches that wipe off

Creamy patches on gum or tongue.

wearAtNight.label: Dentures in at night

drowsy.label: Drowsy or muddled

More sleepy or confused than normal.

cheekSwollen.label: Cheek swollen

Swelling near the ear or jaw.

onsetWhen.label: When it started

happenedWhen.label: When it happened

injuryFirst.label: Hurt in a fall or injury

cannotWalk.label: Cannot stand on it

cannotBend.label: Cannot bend knee right angle

boneTender.label: Bone hurts when pressed

Pain over the bone, not the soft part.

looksBent.label: Looks bent or out of shape

The limb or joint has a wrong shape.

boneThrough.label: Bone or wound through skin

Skin is open over the injury.

cannotUse.label: Cannot use or move it

numbTingle.label: Numb or pins and needles

armNumbWeak.label: Numb or weak arm or hand

coldPale.label: Limb cold, pale or blue

legWeak.label: New weakness in legs

numbGroin.label: Numb around bottom or private parts

No feeling where you sit on a saddle.

bladderBowel.label: Trouble with urine or stool

Cannot pass, or leaking without knowing.

feverish.label: Fever or shivering
feverish.help:
Hot, sweaty or shaking with cold.

weightLoss.label: Cancer before or weight loss

Past cancer, or weight falling with no diet.

steroidBone.label: Weak bones or long-term steroids

Thin bones, or steroid tablets for months.

chestTight.label: Chest pain, tightness or sweating
chestTight.help:
A heavy or tight chest, or sweating.

calfSwollen.label: One leg swollen or calf sore

One leg bigger than the other, or a tender calf.

clotRisk.label: Long trip, surgery or bed rest lately

Long sitting or lying in recent weeks.

jointStuck.label: Cannot move the joint at all
jointStuck.help:

stiffLength.label: Morning stiffness lasts

Time until you loosen up.

jointSwollen.label: Swollen, warm joints

Puffy joints such as fingers or wrists.

shoulderHip.label: Shoulder or hip muscles stiff
shoulderHip.help:
Both shoulders or hips ache and feel stiff.

headScalpJaw.label: New headache, scalp pain or sore jaw chewing
headScalpJaw.help:

visionLoss.label: Vision blurred or lost

Seeing less or seeing double.

atNight.label: Mostly at night
atNight.help:

lowFluids.label: Drinking little, vomiting or loose stools
lowFluids.help:
Low fluids or fluid loss.

firstTime.label: First time like this

You never had this before.

nonBlanching.label: Spots stay red under a glass
nonBlanching.help:
Dark red or purple spots that do not fade.

stiffNeckLight.label: Stiff neck with headache or light hurts

Chin will not touch chest, or light hurts.

lowUrine.label: Passing little or dark urine
lowUrine.help:
Much less urine, or brown colour.

rashNearEye.label: Rash near eye or on nose
rashNearEye.help:
Blisters on the forehead, eyelid or nose.

mouthEyeSores.label: Sores in mouth or eyes, or skin peeling
mouthEyeSores.help:

skinMarks.label: Any rash or marks on skin
skinMarks.help:
Red, raised or scratched skin.

faintDizzy.label: Dizzy, faint or pale
faintDizzy.help:
Light-headed, weak legs or grey face.

bellyVomit.label: Belly pain or vomiting
bellyVomit.help:
Cramps in the belly or being sick.

trigger.label: Soon after food, sting or medicine

Within an hour of something new.

hasPen.label: Has an adrenaline pen
hasPen.help:
A pen you use for bad allergy.

rubbedBurnt.label: From rubbing, burn or sun
rubbedBurnt.help:
A clear cause such as a tight shoe.

oneSideBand.label: Band of pain or blisters on one side
oneSideBand.help:
Burning pain and blisters in a stripe.
Early treatment works best.

sunArea.label: Sunburn covers
sunArea.help:
The size of the burnt skin.

woundDischarge.label: Fluid or pus from it
woundDischarge.help:
Wet or oozing from the wound.

woundColour.label: Colour of the fluid
woundColour.help:

woundSmell.label: Bad smell
woundSmell.help:
An unpleasant smell from the wound.

blackSkin.label: Black or dead-looking skin

Black, grey or hard skin on or near it.

sorePhase.label: Skin looks

moleNew.label: Mole is new in last year
moleNew.help:

skinCancerBefore.label: Skin cancer before or in family
skinCancerBefore.help:
Past skin cancer, or a close relative had it.

hairPattern.label: Hair loss pattern
hairPattern.help:
The pattern of hair loss.

scalpSore.label: Scalp red, sore or scaly
scalpSore.help:

recentStress.label: Illness, birth or big stress lately
recentStress.help:

tiredCold.label: Tired, cold or weight change
tiredCold.help:

noKnock.label: Bruises with no knock

tinyDots.label: Tiny red or purple dots

newMedSteroid.label: New medicine lately

stuckOnFloor.label: Could not get up alone
stuckOnFloor.help:

longOnFloor.label: Lay on floor over 1 hour
longOnFloor.help:
A long time lying after the fall.

standingDizzy.label: Dizzy on standing up

nearFaint.label: Felt faint or nearly blacked out

Vision narrows or you almost pass out.

heartRacing.label: Heart racing or chest pain

weakSide.label: Face droop, arm weak or speech odd

fallsBefore.label: Fallen before in past year

vomitedMore.label: Vomited more than once

Shaking or blank staring spell.

headacheBad.label: Headache getting worse

Pain in the head that keeps growing.

weakVision.label: Weak, numb, vision or speech change

clearFluid.label: Blood or clear fluid from nose or ear

Watery or bloody drip from nose or ear.

cutDeep.label: Deep, gaping or fat or bone seen

dirtInside.label: Dirt or glass inside

Something stuck in the wound.

tetanusOld.label: No tetanus jab in 10 years

bleedSite.label: Bleeding from
bleedSite.help:

heavyBleed.label: Soaking towel or clothes fast

burnCause.label: Caused by

burnSite.label: Burn is on

smokeFace.label: Smoke, singed hair or hoarse voice

coolWater.label: Cooled under cool water 20 minutes

tightLump.label: Swelling growing or feels tight

sprainSite.label: Injured part

biteSite.label: On face, hand, joint or private part
biteSite.help:

hivesBody.label: Hives or itch away from the sting
