The airway is blocked.

lostResponse.label: Floppy or not responding
lostResponse.help:
No answer when spoken to.
This is an emergency.

stuckFeeling.label: Still feels stuck
stuckFeeling.help:
Food or object feels stuck in throat.
It may still block or scratch the gullet.

legTurned.label: Leg shorter or turned outward
legTurned.help:
The foot points out or the leg looks short.
This is a sign of a broken hip.

openSore.label: Open sore, blister or black skin
openSore.help:
Broken skin on the foot.
Foot sores can turn serious, especially with diabetes.

q_coffee.ask: Did it look like coffee grounds?

q_urine.ask: Have you passed urine in the last 8 hours?

q_temp.ask: Did you check your temperature? Say the number.

q_armjaw.ask: Does it spread to your arm, jaw or back?

q_atrest.ask: Is it hard even when resting?

q_getup.ask: Could you get up by yourself?

q_worst.ask: Did it start suddenly, the worst ever?

q_face.ask: Is one side of the face drooping?

q_armweak.ask: Is an arm or leg weak?

q_standing.ask: Does it happen when you stand up?

q_lips.ask: Any swelling of lips, face or tongue?

q_newmed.ask: Did you start a new medicine recently?

q_cannotpass.ask: Are you unable to pass urine?

q_selfharm.ask: Are you having thoughts of hurting yourself?

q_severity.ask: How bad is it? Say a number from 0 to 10.

q_bleedstop.ask: Does the bleeding stop when you press on it?

q_thinner.ask: Do you take a blood thinner?

q_reading.ask: What was the reading? Say the number.

q_chestFaint.ask: Did you faint, or nearly faint?
q_chestFaint.help:
Passing out, or feeling you would.
Fainting with chest or heart signs can mean danger.

q_chestSick.ask: Do you feel sick, or have you vomited?
q_chestSick.help:
Feeling sick or throwing up with the pain.
Some heart attacks show as sickness.

q_painMinutes.ask: How many minutes has it lasted so far?
q_painMinutes.help:
How long the pain has gone on until now.
Pain past 15 minutes needs urgent care.

q_worseBreathing.ask: Is it worse when you breathe in or cough?
q_worseBreathing.help:
The pain changes with each breath.
This helps tell lung pain from heart pain.

q_palpMinutes.ask: How many minutes has it lasted?
q_palpMinutes.help:
How long this spell has gone on.
Long spells need a heart check.

q_palpRegular.ask: Is the beat steady or uneven?
q_palpRegular.help:
Steady means evenly spaced beats.
An uneven beat needs a heart check.

q_pulseRate.ask: If you counted your pulse, say the number.
q_pulseRate.help:
Beats in one minute, felt at the wrist.
A very fast pulse needs care.

q_palpChest.ask: Do you have chest pain with it?
q_palpChest.help:
Pain or tightness in the chest during the spell.
Chest pain with a racing heart is urgent.

q_palpFaint.ask: Do you feel faint or dizzy with it?
q_palpFaint.help:
Light-headed, or about to pass out.
It can mean the heart is not pumping well.

q_breathTalk.ask: Do you run out of breath when you talk?
q_breathTalk.help:
You cannot finish a sentence without a gasp.
It shows how severe the breathing trouble is.

q_blueLips.ask: Are the lips or face turning blue?
q_blueLips.help:
Blue or grey colour.
Not enough air is getting in.

q_breathChest.ask: Is there chest pain when you breathe in?
q_breathChest.help:
A sharp pain with each deep breath.
It can point to a lung clot or lung problem.

q_oxygenBand.help:
The number on a finger oxygen meter.
Low readings need care the same day.

q_usesInhaler.help:
A breathing inhaler.
Tells us if this has happened before.

q_inhalerNoHelp.ask: Is the puffer not helping enough?
q_inhalerNoHelp.help:
The puffer gave little or no relief.
A puffer that fails is an emergency sign.

q_bloodAmount.ask: How much blood was in it?
q_bloodAmount.help:
A rough amount of blood coughed up.
More blood means more danger.

q_coughFever.ask: Have you had fever with it?
q_coughFever.help:
Feeling hot, or a high temperature.
Fever with blood in cough needs a doctor.

q_weightLossLately.ask: Have you lost weight without trying?
q_weightLossLately.help:
Weight fell, and you did not diet.
This can be a warning sign.

q_weightUp.ask: Have you put on weight fast in a few days?
q_weightUp.help:
Weight went up quickly, over days.
It can mean the body is holding water.

q_swellDays.ask: For how many days has it been swollen?
q_swellDays.help:
How long the swelling has been there.
New swelling is checked sooner.

q_legPainful.help:
Pain or tenderness in the calf.
One painful swollen leg needs a same-day check.

q_snoreLoud.help:
Loud enough for others to hear.
Loud snoring with pauses is a warning sign.

q_apneaWitnessed.ask: Has anyone seen you stop breathing in sleep?
q_apneaWitnessed.help:
Someone saw pauses in your breathing.
Pauses strain the heart and brain.

q_wakeGasping.ask: Do you wake up gasping or choking?
q_wakeGasping.help:
Waking suddenly short of breath.
It shows the breathing stops at night.

q_daySleepy.ask: Are you very sleepy in the day?
q_daySleepy.help:
You doze off when sitting or reading.
Daytime sleep raises the risk of accidents.

q_bpToldHigh.ask: Have you been told your BP is high?
q_bpToldHigh.help:
A doctor said your pressure is high.
Night breathing problems and BP go together.

q_snoreDrive.ask: Do you nod off while driving?
q_snoreDrive.help:
You doze at the wheel or in traffic.
This is a road safety danger.

q_nightChest.ask: Chest pain or racing heart in your sleep?
q_nightChest.help:
Chest pain or fast beats that wake you.
It can mean the heart is strained.

q_sysBp.ask: What is the top BP number?
q_sysBp.help:
The first, larger number of a BP reading.
Very high numbers need same-day care.

q_diaBp.ask: What is the bottom BP number?
q_diaBp.help:
The second, smaller number of a BP reading.
A very high bottom number also needs care.

q_onBpTablets.help:
Daily tablets for blood pressure.
Missed tablets often explain high readings.

q_missedBpTablets.ask: Have you missed any BP tablets lately?
q_missedBpTablets.help:
Skipped or forgotten doses.
It may be the simple cause.

q_strokeSigns.ask: Any face drooping, weak arm or leg, or slurred speech?
q_strokeSigns.help:
Any sudden weakness of face, limb or speech.
These can be signs of a stroke.

q_bpChest.ask: Do you have any chest pain?
q_bpChest.help:
Pain or pressure in the chest.
Chest pain with BP trouble is urgent.

q_lowBpBand.ask: What was the top BP number?
q_lowBpBand.help:
The first number of your BP reading.
Below 90 is low and needs care.

q_lowFluidLoss.ask: Lately, vomiting, loose motions or drinking little?
q_lowFluidLoss.help:
Losing or not taking in enough fluid.
Dry body is a common cause of low BP.

q_faintWeak.ask: Do you feel faint, dizzy or very weak?
q_faintWeak.help:
Light-headed, unsteady or drained.
It can mean blood loss or low BP.

q_bellyBlood.ask: Have you vomited blood, or passed black sticky stool?
q_bellyBlood.help:
Blood from the mouth, or tar-like stool.
This means bleeding inside the gut.

q_hoursPain.ask: For how many hours has it lasted?
q_hoursPain.help:
How long the pain has gone on.
Pain that lasts hours needs a doctor.

q_bellyWhere.ask: Where is the pain in your belly?
q_bellyWhere.help:
The spot that hurts most.
The spot helps the doctor judge the cause.

q_bellyHard.ask: Is your belly hard, or very sore if touched?
q_bellyHard.help:
The belly is stiff, or hurts on a light touch.
It can mean a serious problem inside.

q_noWind.ask: Can you not pass wind or stool?
q_noWind.help:
Nothing is coming out, not even wind.
It can mean the gut is blocked.

q_bellyBloat.help:
The belly looks or feels bigger than usual.
Swelling with a blocked gut is urgent.

q_vomitWith.ask: Have you been vomiting with it?
q_vomitWith.help:
Throwing up along with the problem.
Vomiting with other signs can mean a block.

q_daysSoFar.ask: For how many days has this gone on?
q_daysSoFar.help:
How long since it started.
Longer illness needs a check.

q_newMedicine.ask: Any new medicine in the past few weeks?
q_newMedicine.help:
A medicine started or changed recently.
Some medicines can cause this.

q_cantKeepFluids.ask: Are you unable to keep drinks down?
q_cantKeepFluids.help:
You bring up nearly everything you drink.
The body can dry out fast.

q_noUrine8h.ask: Have you passed no urine for 8 hours?
q_noUrine8h.help:
No urine at all in the last 8 hours.
The kidneys may be in trouble.

q_headNeck.ask: Bad headache, stiff neck or confusion?
q_headNeck.help:
A very bad headache, neck too stiff to bend, or muddled thinking.
Sickness with these can be a brain danger.

q_nauseaChest.ask: Any chest pain or chest tightness?
q_nauseaChest.help:
Pain or pressure in the chest.
Feeling sick can be a heart sign.

q_vomitGreen.ask: Is the vomit green or yellow-green?
q_vomitGreen.help:
Bright green or yellow-green fluid.
It can mean the gut is blocked.

q_coffee_v.ask: Did it look like coffee grounds?
q_coffee_v.help:
Dark brown specks, like coffee powder.
It shows old blood from the stomach.

q_projectile.ask: Does the baby vomit with force, shooting out?
q_projectile.help:
Vomit that shoots out far.
In young babies it can mean a blocked stomach outlet.

q_vomitBloodAmount.help:
A rough amount of blood in the vomit.
More blood means more danger.

q_takesPainkillers.ask: Do you take aspirin or painkiller tablets?
q_takesPainkillers.help:
Tablets such as aspirin or ibuprofen.
They can hurt the stomach lining.

q_daysNoStool.ask: How many days since you passed stool?
q_daysNoStool.help:
Days since the last proper stool.
More than a week needs a check.

q_bowelChange.ask: Any new change in your toilet habits?
q_bowelChange.help:
Loose or hard stools that are new for you.
New bowel change needs a check.

q_stoolBloodColour.help:
The colour of blood in your stool.
Dark blood comes from higher up in the gut.

q_stoolBloodAmount.help:
A rough amount of blood.
More blood means more danger.

q_vomitBloodToo.ask: Did you also vomit blood or coffee-like fluid?
q_vomitBloodToo.help:
Blood or dark fluid coming up.
It means bleeding higher up in the gut.

q_flankPain.ask: Do you have pain in your side or back?
q_flankPain.help:
Pain below the ribs, to one side.
It can mean a kidney problem.

q_rigors.help:
Shivering you cannot stop.
It can mean infection in the blood.

q_urinePerDay.ask: How many times do you pass urine in a day?
q_urinePerDay.help:
Number of times in 24 hours.
It helps judge how bad this is.

q_nightTimes.ask: How many times do you wake to pass urine?
q_nightTimes.help:
Trips to the toilet at night.
Many night trips need a check.

q_veryThirsty.ask: Are you very thirsty, or peeing much more?
q_veryThirsty.help:
Thirst or passing lots of urine.
High sugar dries the mouth.

q_noEmpty.ask: Does your bladder never feel empty?
q_noEmpty.help:
You still feel full after passing urine.
It can mean the bladder is not emptying.

q_bladderPain.ask: Is your lower belly painful or very full?
q_bladderPain.help:
Pain or tightness low in the belly.
It means the bladder may be full.

q_dropsOnly.help:
A weak dribble, not a stream.
It can mean the flow is blocked.

q_saddleNumb.ask: Is the skin between your legs numb?
q_saddleNumb.help:
Loss of feeling in the groin and bottom.
The spinal nerves may be squeezed.

q_urineBloodColour.help:
The colour of the urine with blood.
Clots and bright red mean more danger.

q_leakWhen.help:
What brings on the leak.
The pattern helps find the cause.

q_bowelLeak.help:
Stool comes out without warning.
With urine leak it can mean nerve trouble.

q_painWaves.ask: Does the pain come in waves?
q_painWaves.help:
It rises, eases, then rises again.
Wave pain can mean a stone.

q_urineBloodSeen.ask: Is there blood in your urine?
q_urineBloodSeen.help:
Red or pink urine.
It helps find a kidney or bladder cause.

q_swollenLegsToo.help:
Swelling of feet or ankles.
Face and leg swelling can mean kidney or heart trouble.

q_foamyUrine.help:
Lots of froth that stays.
Froth can mean protein leaking.

q_lessUrine.ask: Are you passing much less urine?
q_lessUrine.help:
Clearly less than your usual amount.
The kidneys may not be working well.

q_periodPainNew.ask: Is the pain new, or much worse than usual?
q_periodPainNew.help:
Not your usual period pain.
New pain needs a check.

q_periodLate.help:
More than a week past the due date.
A late period changes what the pain could be.

q_maybePregnant.help:
You might be pregnant.
Pregnancy changes how urgent this is.

q_padsHour.ask: Are you soaking a pad every hour?
q_padsHour.help:
A full pad each hour for 2 hours or more.
This is dangerous blood loss.

q_bleedDays.ask: For how many days have you bled?
q_bleedDays.help:
Days since the bleeding began.
Bleeding past 7 days needs a check.

q_bigClots.ask: Are there big clots, as large as a coin?
q_bigClots.help:
Clots bigger than a one rupee coin.
Big clots show heavy bleeding.

q_monthsSincePeriod.ask: How many months since your last period?
q_monthsSincePeriod.help:
Months without a period.
A year or more means periods have stopped.

q_bleedAmount.help:
A rough amount of bleeding.
Heavier bleeding needs faster care.

q_onHrt.ask: Do you use hormone tablets or patches?
q_onHrt.help:
Hormones for menopause.
They can cause some bleeding.

q_pelvicPain.ask: Do you have pain low in the belly?
q_pelvicPain.help:
Pain below the belly button.
It can mean infection or another cause.

q_dischargeColour.help:
The colour you see.
Colour helps tell the cause.

q_fishySmell.ask: Does it have a fishy smell?
q_fishySmell.help:
A strong, fish-like smell.
Smell helps tell the cause.

q_riskSex.ask: Any new partner or unprotected sex lately?
q_riskSex.help:
Sex without a condom, or with someone new.
It tells if an infection test is needed.

q_lumpGrowing.help:
It is larger than when you first saw it.
Growing lumps need a check.

q_lumpHard.ask: Is the lump hard and does it not move?
q_lumpHard.help:
It feels like a stone stuck under the skin.
Hard, fixed lumps need a check.

q_skinChange.ask: Is the skin dimpled, like orange peel?
q_skinChange.help:
Puckered or pitted breast skin.
It is a warning sign.

q_nippleChange.ask: Is the nipple turned in, or leaking blood?
q_nippleChange.help:
A new nipple change or a bloody leak.
It is a warning sign.

q_armpitLump.ask: Is there a lump in the armpit?
q_armpitLump.help:
A swelling under the arm.
It may need testing.

q_painCyclic.ask: Is it worse before your period?
q_painCyclic.help:
Pain rises in the week before a period.
This pattern is usually harmless.

q_breastLump.help:
A hard spot in the breast.
A lump needs a doctor within 2 weeks.

q_breastfeeding.help:
Feeding a baby with breast milk.
Feeding can cause a blocked or infected breast.

q_flushPerDay.help:
Count of hot spells in 24 hours.
It tells how much this affects you.

q_periodsChanged.ask: Have your periods stopped or changed?
q_periodsChanged.help:
Late, missed or different periods.
It fits the change of life.

q_nightSoaking.ask: Do you soak the bed with sweat at night?
q_nightSoaking.help:
Night sweat that wets clothes or sheets.
Soaking sweats can have other causes.

q_racingHeart.help:
Fast or pounding beats.
A racing heart with heat can be another cause.

q_bleedAfterStop.ask: Any bleeding after your periods stopped?
q_bleedAfterStop.help:
Blood from the vagina after menopause.
It always needs a check.

q_bloatDaily.help:
Bloating on most days of the month.
Daily bloating that lasts needs a check.

q_earlySatiety.ask: Do you feel full after a few bites?
q_earlySatiety.help:
You cannot finish a normal meal.
It can be an early warning sign.

q_bellySwollenFast.help:
It grows over days or weeks.
Fast swelling needs a check.

q_foodSticks.ask: Does food stick when you swallow?
q_foodSticks.help:
Food seems to stop in the chest or throat.
It needs a check within days.

q_chokeCough.ask: Do you choke or cough when you eat?
q_chokeCough.help:
Food or drink goes down the wrong way.
Food in the lungs can cause a chest infection.

q_regurgitate.ask: Does food come back up unchanged?
q_regurgitate.help:
Whole food returns to the mouth.
It can mean food is held up.

q_swallowWhat.help:
The food that gives trouble.
It shows how bad the block is.

q_droolSaliva.ask: Can you not swallow your own spit?
q_droolSaliva.help:
Spit pools or drools out.
It means a full block. It is an emergency.

q_foodStuckNow.help:
Food is stuck and will not go down.
A stuck lump can block breathing.

q_hiccupHours.ask: For how many hours have the hiccups gone on?
q_hiccupHours.help:
Hours since they began.
Hiccups over 48 hours need a check.

q_darkUrine.help:
Urine looks dark yellow or brown.
Dark urine shows the body is short of water.

q_paleStool.ask: Is your stool pale or clay coloured?
q_paleStool.help:
Stool lost its brown colour.
It means bile may be blocked.

q_upperRightPain.ask: Do you have pain in the upper right belly?
q_upperRightPain.help:
Pain under the right ribs.
It can mean a bile duct problem.

q_tooManyTablets.ask: Did you take more paracetamol than advised?
q_tooManyTablets.help:
More tablets than the pack says.
Too much harms the liver, even if you feel fine.

q_pillows.ask: How many pillows do you need to sleep?
q_pillows.help:
Pillows you stack to breathe easier.
Needing more pillows can mean fluid in the lungs.

q_howLong.ask: How long has this been going on?
q_howLong.help:
How many days or weeks you have had this.
Short and long problems need different care.

q_diabetes.help:
A sugar problem that needs tablets or insulin.
Healing and infection risk are higher.

q_tooWeak.ask: Are you too weak to stand?
q_tooWeak.help:
You cannot get up or stand on your own.
Being this weak can mean a serious illness.

q_feverRash.ask: Any rash that stays when pressed?
q_feverRash.help:
Press a clear glass on the rash. It stays red or purple.
This can be a sign of a serious infection.

q_lowImmunity.ask: Do you take steroids or cancer medicine?
q_lowImmunity.help:
Medicines that lower the body's defence against germs.
Infections can turn serious faster then.

q_chestDiscomfort.ask: Any pain or pressure in your chest?
q_chestDiscomfort.help:
A tight, heavy or aching feeling in the chest.
It can be a sign of a heart problem.

q_unplannedWeightLoss.ask: Are you losing weight without trying?
q_unplannedWeightLoss.help:
Your weight is dropping and you are not dieting.
This needs a check even if you feel well.

q_lowInterest.ask: Have you lost interest in things you enjoy?
q_lowInterest.help:
Not enjoying things you used to like.
Low mood can hide behind tiredness.

q_weakOneSide.ask: Is one side of your body weak or numb?
q_weakOneSide.help:
An arm, leg or the face feels weak or numb on one side.
This can be a sign of a stroke.

q_spreadingUp.ask: Is weakness creeping up from your feet?
q_spreadingUp.help:
Weakness starts in the toes and climbs to the legs.
This pattern needs a doctor quickly.

q_cantSwallowWater.ask: Is swallowing water hard or not possible?
q_cantSwallowWater.help:
Water will not go down, or makes you choke.
You may get dry or not get enough medicine.

q_yellowSkin.ask: Are your skin or eyes yellow?
q_yellowSkin.help:
Yellow tint to skin or eye whites.
This can mean a liver problem.

q_bellyPain.help:
Pain anywhere between the ribs and the hips.
Belly pain changes what we check.

q_peeingMore.ask: Are you passing much more urine than usual?
q_peeingMore.help:
You go to the toilet far more often to pass urine.
It can go with high sugar or dryness.

q_nightSweatsAlso.ask: Do you get drenching sweats at night?
q_nightSweatsAlso.help:
Sweat that soaks your clothes or sheets.
It can go with infection or other illness.

q_longCough.ask: Have you had a cough for over 3 weeks?
q_longCough.help:
A cough that has not gone away in 3 weeks.
A long cough needs a chest check.

q_swallowHard.ask: Does food stick when you swallow?
q_swallowHard.help:
Food feels stuck in the throat or chest.
It can mean a blockage.

q_onPurpose.ask: Are you trying to lose weight?
q_onPurpose.help:
You are dieting or exercising to lose weight.
If yes, we ask fewer questions.

q_weightLostKg.ask: How much weight have you lost, in kg?
q_weightLostKg.help:
Kilograms lost, as best you know.
A big drop is more worrying.

q_nightsPerWeek.ask: How many nights a week do you sweat?
q_nightsPerWeek.help:
Count the nights in a usual week.
Often is more worrying than rare.

q_lumpNeckArmpit.ask: Any lumps in your neck or armpit?
q_lumpNeckArmpit.help:
Small hard swellings under the skin there.
Glands swell with infection and other illness.

q_sugarBand.help:
Pick the band for your meter reading in mg/dL.
Low and high sugar both need quick action.

q_takesSugarMedicine.ask: Do you take insulin or sugar tablets?
q_takesSugarMedicine.help:
Medicine that lowers blood sugar.
These can cause low sugar.

q_vomitOrLoose.ask: Have you been vomiting or had loose stools?
q_vomitOrLoose.help:
Being sick or passing watery stools.
These can dry out the body.

q_dizzyOnStanding.ask: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
q_dizzyOnStanding.help:
The head spins or goes light on standing.
It can show low water or low blood pressure.

q_onWaterPills.help:
Tablets that make you pass more urine.
They can dry the body out.

q_selfHarmPlan.ask: Have you thought about how you might do it?
q_selfHarmPlan.help:
Thinking of a way or a time.
It helps us see how urgent help is.

q_selfHarmNow.ask: Do you feel unsafe right now?
q_selfHarmNow.help:
Worried you may act on these thoughts soon.
If yes, we will point you to help now.

q_selfHarmActed.ask: Have you hurt yourself or taken extra tablets today?
q_selfHarmActed.help:
Any harm to yourself or extra medicine, today.
Quick medical care may be needed.

q_notAlone.ask: Is someone with you right now?
q_notAlone.help:
A person is near you at this moment.
Being with someone makes you safer.

q_fastHeart.help:
You feel fast or pounding beats.
It can come from worry or a heart problem.

q_sleepTrouble.help:
Falling asleep, waking at night, or waking early.
Each type has a different cause.

q_wakesBreathless.ask: Do you wake up short of breath?
q_wakesBreathless.help:
You wake suddenly and gasp for air.
It can be a heart or lung problem.

q_snoring.ask: Do you snore loudly or stop breathing in sleep?
q_snoring.help:
Others hear loud snoring or pauses in breath.
It can ruin sleep and tire you.

q_hardToWake.ask: Is the person drowsy or hard to wake?
q_hardToWake.help:
Sleepy, or slow to open eyes.
It can mean a serious illness.

q_recentLoss.ask: Have you lost someone close lately?
q_recentLoss.help:
A death or a big loss in recent months.
Loss can bring low mood and loneliness.

q_noOneToTalk.ask: Is there no one you can talk to?
q_noOneToTalk.help:
No friend or family you can call.
Having someone to talk to protects health.

q_unsafeAtHome.ask: Does anyone at home make you feel unsafe?
q_unsafeAtHome.help:
Someone shouts at you, hurts you or takes your money.
We ask so you can get safe help.

q_hallucType.ask: What do you see or hear?
q_hallucType.help:
Seeing things, hearing voices, or both.
The type helps us judge the cause.

q_voicesHarm.ask: Do the voices tell you to hurt anyone?
q_voicesHarm.help:
Voices that give orders to harm you or others.
This needs help right away.

q_stoppedAlcohol.ask: Did you stop drinking alcohol in the last few days?
q_stoppedAlcohol.help:
Heavy drinkers who stop can become unwell.
Stopping suddenly can be dangerous.

q_shaky.ask: Do you feel shaky or very hungry?
q_shaky.help:
Trembling hands or a sudden strong hunger.
These are early signs of low sugar.

q_skippedMeal.ask: Did you miss a meal or take extra medicine?
q_skippedMeal.help:
Not eating, or more tablets or insulin than usual.
It is a common cause of low sugar.

q_footSore.ask: Any sore, blister or wound on your foot?
q_footSore.help:
Broken skin, a blister or a cut on the foot.
Foot wounds heal badly with numbness.

q_footColdPale.ask: Is a foot cold, pale or blue?
q_footColdPale.help:
One foot looks whiter or bluer than the other.
The blood flow may be blocked.

q_lumpWhere.help:
Pick the place that fits best.
The place changes who should see it.

q_lumpRedHot.ask: Is the lump red, hot or leaking pus?
q_lumpRedHot.help:
The skin over it is red and warm.
It may be infected.

q_cannotPushBack.ask: Is it painful and will it not go back in?
q_cannotPushBack.help:
A groin or belly lump that hurts and will not push in.
The gut may be trapped.

q_heavyPeriods.ask: Are your periods or other bleeding heavy?
q_heavyPeriods.help:
Soaking pads fast, or passing clots.
Blood loss can make you pale.

q_whenAfterMedicine.ask: How soon after the medicine did it start?
q_whenAfterMedicine.help:
Pick the time between the tablet and the problem.
Quick onset can mean a strong reaction.

q_throatTight.ask: Is your throat tight, or voice hoarse?
q_throatTight.help:
Tight throat, odd voice or noisy breath.
The airway may be closing.

q_rashHives.ask: Do you have an itchy rash or raised lumps?
q_rashHives.help:
Red, raised, itchy patches on the skin.
A rash can be a reaction to medicine.

q_skinPeeling.ask: Any blisters, peeling skin or sore mouth or eyes?
q_skinPeeling.help:
Skin lifting off, or painful sores in mouth or eyes.
This can be a severe medicine reaction.

q_unusualBleeding.ask: Any bleeding or bruising you cannot explain?
q_unusualBleeding.help:
Gums, nose or skin bleed or bruise easily.
Some medicines make bleeding more likely.

q_legSwollen.ask: Is one leg swollen, red or sore?
q_legSwollen.help:
One calf is bigger or hurts more than the other.
It can be a blood clot.

q_fellRecently.ask: Have you fallen in the past month?
q_fellRecently.help:
Any fall, even without injury.
Falls show a higher risk of a bad fall.

q_coughsChokes.ask: Do you cough or choke when eating or drinking?
q_coughsChokes.help:
Coughing during or just after a swallow.
Food may go down the wrong way.

q_mouthSore.ask: Do you have a sore mouth, bad teeth or loose dentures?
q_mouthSore.help:
Pain or trouble when chewing.
Mouth problems are easy to fix.

q_painSwallowing.ask: Does it hurt when you swallow?
q_painSwallowing.help:
A sharp or burning pain as food goes down.
Pain can point to a throat or food pipe problem.

q_whichAccident.help:
Urine, stool, or both.
The type helps us find the cause.

q_burnsPeeing.ask: Does it burn when you pass urine?
q_burnsPeeing.help:
A stinging or burning pain when urine passes.
It can mean a urine infection.

q_painWhere.help:
Pick the main place.
The place tells us what to check.

q_cancerHistory.help:
A past cancer, even if treated.
Old cancers can come back as night pain.

q_selfHarmCalm.ask: Have you had thoughts of hurting yourself?
q_selfHarmCalm.help:
Thoughts of ending your life or harming yourself.
Many people have these. Help is available, and we ask to keep you safe.

q_walkHead.ask: Did you hit your head in the fall?
q_walkHead.help:
Any knock to the head when you fell.
Head injuries can bleed slowly, more so on blood thinners.

q_walkThinner.ask: Do you take a blood thinner?
q_walkThinner.help:
Tablets like warfarin, apixaban, or aspirin to thin the blood.
Bleeding after a fall is more risky on these.

q_eatFace.ask: Is one side of the face drooping?
q_eatFace.help:
One side of the face looks lower or uneven.
With sudden swallow trouble, this can be a stroke.

q_painArmJaw.ask: Does the pain spread to your arm, jaw or back?
q_painArmJaw.help:
Pain moving from the chest to arm, jaw or back.
This can be a sign of a heart problem.

q_painBreathless.help:
You feel short of air.
With chest pain, this can be serious.

q_accCount.ask: How many accidents in the last week?
q_accCount.help:
Count the accidents in the past 7 days.
More accidents mean a bigger problem.

q_hasDiabetes.help:
Whether the person has diabetes.
Sugar problems can cause this symptom.

q_headKnockWeeks.ask: Any knock to the head in the past 2 weeks?
q_headKnockWeeks.help:
A bump to the head, even a small one.
Slow bleeding can follow a small knock.

q_notDrinking.ask: Are you drinking much less than usual?
q_notDrinking.help:
Drinking far fewer fluids than normal.
Being dry can cause this, more so when older.

q_heartSigns.ask: Chest pain, or a racing or pounding heart with it?
q_heartSigns.help:
Pain in the chest or a heart that races.
The heart can be the cause.

q_bleedSigns.ask: Any black stool, or blood in vomit?
q_bleedSigns.help:
Stool like tar, or blood when being sick.
Hidden bleeding can cause this.

q_notRecovered.ask: Are you still confused, or not back to normal?
q_notRecovered.help:
Still muddled or drowsy after the event.
It should clear in minutes; if not, it needs urgent care.

q_settledAlready.help:
The problem came and went.
Symptoms that clear can still be a warning.

q_breathTrouble.ask: Is it hard to breathe, or is your breathing noisy?
q_breathTrouble.help:
Struggling for air or a noisy, high sound.
The airway may be narrowing.

q_swellingLipsThroat.ask: Are your lips, tongue or throat swelling?
q_swellingLipsThroat.help:
Swelling of the mouth or throat.
This can close the airway fast.

q_scalpJawPain.ask: Is your scalp tender, or does your jaw hurt when chewing?
q_scalpJawPain.help:
Sore scalp when touched, or jaw ache while eating.
In people over 50, this can harm sight if missed.

q_mouthOpen.ask: Can you open your mouth fully?
q_mouthOpen.help:
Opening wide without pain or a stuck feeling.
A stuck jaw can mean a deep infection.

q_neckLump.ask: Have you found a new lump in your neck?
q_neckLump.help:
A swelling you can feel in the neck.
A lump that stays needs a check.

q_swallowHurts.help:
Food or drink hurts or sticks going down.
It can point to a throat problem.

q_usesTobacco.ask: Do you smoke or chew tobacco, paan or betel?
q_usesTobacco.help:
Any tobacco use, smoked or chewed.
Tobacco raises the chance of mouth and throat problems.

q_afterHeadKnock.ask: Did it start after a knock to the head?
q_afterHeadKnock.help:
It began after a head injury.
A head injury can damage the skull or ear.

q_hearingDrop.ask: Is your hearing worse on that side?
q_hearingDrop.help:
Sounds are quieter than before.
Sudden hearing loss needs quick care.

q_earFluid.ask: Is any fluid or pus coming from the ear?
q_earFluid.help:
Wet or sticky fluid from the ear.
It shows the ear skin or drum may be damaged.

q_noseBloodStained.ask: Is the fluid from your nose blood-stained?
q_noseBloodStained.help:
Pink or red streaks in nose fluid.
Bloody fluid on one side needs a check.

q_clearFluidAfterKnock.ask: Is clear, watery fluid dripping after a head knock?
q_clearFluidAfterKnock.help:
Thin fluid like water from nose or ear.
It can be brain fluid leaking.

q_eyelidSwollen.ask: Is an eyelid or the skin round your eye red and swollen?
q_eyelidSwollen.help:
Puffy, red skin around the eye.
An infection behind the eye can harm sight.

q_faceSinusPain.ask: Is there pain or pressure in your cheeks or forehead?
q_faceSinusPain.help:
Ache over the sinuses.
It helps tell a sinus problem from a cold.

q_otherBleeding.ask: Bleeding from gums, nose, urine or stool?
q_otherBleeding.help:
Blood from anywhere else.
It may mean blood does not clot well.

q_feelFaint.ask: Do you feel faint, dizzy or very weak?
q_feelFaint.help:
Light-headed, like you may pass out.
It can mean a lot of blood has been lost.

q_eyeInjury.ask: Did something hit or splash into the eye?
q_eyeInjury.help:
A blow, a chip, or a liquid in the eye.
Eye injuries need quick care to save sight.

q_redEye.help:
The white of the eye looks red.
Red and painful eyes can be serious.

q_lightHurts.ask: Does bright light hurt the eye?
q_lightHurts.help:
Light makes the eye sore.
It can mean the front of the eye is inflamed.

q_eyeHalos.ask: Do you see rainbow rings round lights?
q_eyeHalos.help:
Coloured rings around bright lights.
It can mean high pressure inside the eye.

q_sickWithEye.ask: Do you feel sick, or have a headache with the eye pain?
q_sickWithEye.help:
Nausea, vomiting or head pain with the eye.
It can mean high pressure inside the eye.

q_contactLens.help:
Lenses worn on the eyes.
Lens wearers can get serious eye infections.

q_rashForehead.ask: Is there a blistering rash on your forehead or eyelid?
q_rashForehead.help:
Small blisters on one side of the face.
Shingles near the eye can damage sight.

q_eyeDischarge.ask: Is there sticky yellow or green gunk?
q_eyeDischarge.help:
Thick gunk that glues the lids.
It helps tell an infection from allergy.

q_curtainShadow.ask: Is there a dark curtain or shadow in your sight?
q_curtainShadow.help:
A dark patch that blocks part of the view.
It can mean the retina has come loose.

q_itchySneeze.ask: Are your eyes itchy, or are you sneezing?
q_itchySneeze.help:
Itch in the eyes, nose or throat.
It points to allergy, which is not dangerous.

q_flashesLight.ask: Do you see flashes of light?
q_flashesLight.help:
Sparks or lightning streaks in the sight.
It can mean the retina is pulling.

q_lastWell.ask: What time were you last completely well?
q_lastWell.help:
The last time everything felt normal.
Stroke treatment depends on this time.

q_balanceLost.ask: Did you suddenly lose balance or feel unsteady?
q_balanceLost.help:
Stumbling or swaying with no warning.
It can be a sign of a stroke.

q_bladderBowelChange.ask: Any new trouble passing urine or stool, or leaking?
q_bladderBowelChange.help:
New leaking or not being able to go.
The spinal cord may be squeezed.

q_legsWeakening.ask: Are your legs getting weaker, or is weakness spreading up?
q_legsWeakening.help:
Weakness that gets worse over hours or days.
Nerves can be attacked, and breathing may be hit.

q_urineBurning.ask: Is there burning when you pass urine?
q_urineBurning.help:
Stinging or pain passing water.
Urine infection often confuses older people.

q_bleedMinutes.ask: How many minutes has it been bleeding?
q_bleedMinutes.help:
The time the bleeding has gone on.
Over 20 minutes needs care.

q_bleedsOften.help:
Repeated bleeds over weeks.
Repeat bleeds need a cause found.

q_highBpKnown.ask: Do you have high blood pressure?
q_highBpKnown.help:
A known diagnosis of high pressure.
High pressure can make nosebleeds worse.

q_hd_stiff.ask: Is your neck stiff, or does bending forward hurt?
q_hd_stiff.help:
Hard to touch chin to chest.
Stiff neck with fever or headache can mean brain infection.

q_hd_thinner.ask: Do you take a blood thinner or aspirin?
q_hd_thinner.help:
Medicine that stops blood clotting.
Bleeding lasts longer on these.

q_hd_painful.help:
Pain, not just discomfort.
Pain makes a serious cause more likely.

q_hd_oneside.ask: Is it on one side only?
q_hd_oneside.help:
Only one nostril or side is affected.
One side only can mean something blocks it.

q_hd_faintjerk.ask: Did the body shake or jerk?
q_hd_faintjerk.help:
Arms or legs jerking.
Jerking can point to a fit, not a faint.

q_hd_warning.ask: Any warning first: sweat, sick, or sight dimming?
q_hd_warning.help:
Feeling odd just before.
A warning fits a simple faint.

q_hd_headsame.ask: Did a sudden, very bad headache come with it?
q_hd_headsame.help:
A headache like a thunderclap.
It can mean bleeding around the brain.

q_sickManyTimes.ask: Have you been sick many times, unable to keep fluids?
q_sickManyTimes.help:
Vomiting again and again.
Being dry needs care.

q_painkillerDays.ask: Do you take painkillers on more than 10 days a month?
q_painkillerDays.help:
Tablets for pain most days.
Too many tablets can keep headaches going.

q_migraineUsual.ask: Is this like your usual migraines?
q_migraineUsual.help:
The same as attacks you know.
A new kind of headache needs a check.

q_dizzyLasts.ask: How long does each spell last?
q_dizzyLasts.help:
The length of one spell of dizziness.
Seconds, hours or days point to different causes.

q_dizzyHeadache.ask: Did a sudden bad headache or neck pain come with it?
q_dizzyHeadache.help:
A thunderclap headache or sharp neck pain.
Bleeding or a torn neck vessel can cause both.

q_faintCardiac.ask: Was it during effort, or with chest pain or a racing heart?
q_faintCardiac.help:
Fainting while active, or with heart symptoms.
A heart rhythm problem can cause this.

q_firstEverFit.ask: Is this the first fit you have ever had?
q_firstEverFit.help:
No fits before today.
A first fit needs a full check.

q_fitLong.ask: Did the fit last more than 5 minutes?
q_fitLong.help:
Shaking for longer than 5 minutes.
A long fit is an emergency.

q_fitRepeat.ask: Did another fit come, or before waking up?
q_fitRepeat.help:
More than one fit close together.
Repeated fits are an emergency.

q_earPainRash.ask: Is there ear pain or a blistering rash near the ear?
q_earPainRash.help:
Pain or blisters around the ear.
A nerve infection can also droop the face.

q_speechType.ask: What is wrong with the speech?
q_speechType.help:
How the speech sounds.
Slurred, wrong words or no words point to different causes.

q_weakWhere.help:
The part of the body that is weak.
The place helps the doctor find the cause.

q_numbWhere.help:
The part of the body that is numb.
The place helps the doctor find the cause.

q_hd_dur.ask: How long did the numbness last?
q_hd_dur.help:
How many minutes or hours it lasted.
Short spells that clear can be a warning.

q_hd_side.help:
Left or right side of the body.
One side points to the brain.

q_tinglingWhere.help:
The part of the body that tingles.
The place helps the doctor find the cause.

q_lowB12Diet.ask: Are you vegetarian, or on metformin for years?
q_lowB12Diet.help:
A diet or medicine that can lower vitamin B12.
Low B12 can cause tingling.

q_hd_tside.help:
Left or right side of the body.
One side points to the brain.

q_memoryCourse.help:
Sudden, slow, or on and off.
Sudden loss is an emergency; slow loss needs a check.

q_repeatsQuestions.ask: Do you repeat the same question or story?
q_repeatsQuestions.help:
Asking again and again within minutes.
It is a common early sign.

q_gotLost.ask: Have you got lost somewhere you know well?
q_gotLost.help:
Losing the way in a familiar place.
It is a common early sign.

q_dailyTasksHarder.ask: Is it harder to manage money, meals or medicines?
q_dailyTasksHarder.help:
Everyday jobs that were easy are now hard.
It shows how much memory affects life.

q_moodLow.ask: Do you feel low or lose interest in things?
q_moodLow.help:
Sad most days.
Low mood can look like forgetting.

q_tremorWhen.ask: When do the hands shake most?
q_tremorWhen.help:
At rest, or when using the hands.
Rest shaking and action shaking have different causes.

q_slowStiff.ask: Are you slower, stiffer, or taking smaller steps?
q_slowStiff.help:
Slow movement or stiff limbs.
It can go with Parkinson disease.

q_heartRacingSweat.ask: Is your heart racing, or are you sweating or losing weight?
q_heartRacingSweat.help:
Fast heart, sweats, thinner.
An overactive thyroid can cause shaking.

q_alcoholCut.ask: Do you drink daily and recently cut down?
q_alcoholCut.help:
Heavy drinking, then stopping.
Stopping can cause shaking and fits.

q_feetNumb.ask: Are your feet numb or tingling?
q_feetNumb.help:
Loss of feeling in the feet.
Numb feet make walking unsteady.

q_headacheWithBalance.ask: Is there a new bad headache, or vomiting, with it?
q_headacheWithBalance.help:
A fresh headache or being sick.
Problems at the back of the brain can cause both.

q_earDischargeColour.ask: What does the fluid look like?
q_earDischargeColour.help:
The look of the fluid from the ear.
Blood or clear fluid needs care.

q_swollenBehindEar.ask: Is the skin behind the ear red, swollen or sore?
q_swollenBehindEar.help:
Puffy, red or tender skin behind the ear.
The infection may have spread to the bone.

q_hasRinging.ask: Is there ringing or buzzing in that ear?
q_hasRinging.help:
Noise in the ear with no outside sound.
Ringing with hearing loss needs a check.

q_pulseTinnitus.ask: Does the noise beat with your heartbeat?
q_pulseTinnitus.help:
A whooshing that matches your pulse.
It can come from a blood vessel.

q_tinnitusDistress.ask: Is the noise upsetting your sleep or mood?
q_tinnitusDistress.help:
The noise is hard to bear.
Distress can be treated.

q_earBlocked.ask: Does the ear feel blocked or full?
q_earBlocked.help:
A plugged feeling.
Wax or fluid can cause this.

q_lowImmune.ask: Are you on chemo, steroids, or medicine that lowers immunity?
q_lowImmune.help:
Treatment that weakens the body's defence.
Infections can turn serious fast.

q_bloodInSpit.ask: Is there blood in your spit?
q_bloodInSpit.help:
Streaks or spots of blood.
Blood needs a cause found.

q_lostWeight.ask: Have you lost weight without trying?
q_lostWeight.help:
Clothes are looser, no diet.
It can go with serious illness.

q_afterColdOrShouting.ask: Did it start after a cold or shouting?
q_afterColdOrShouting.help:
A clear trigger like a cold.
A clear cause and quick recovery is reassuring.

q_doubleWorse.ask: Did you get a bit better, then worse again?
q_doubleWorse.help:
A second dip after first easing.
A second dip can mean a bacterial infection.

q_sprayOverWeek.ask: Have you used nose spray for more than a week?
q_sprayOverWeek.help:
Decongestant spray most days.
Long use makes the nose block worse.

q_afterNoseKnock.ask: Did it start after a knock to the nose?
q_afterNoseKnock.help:
A blow to the nose.
A blood bump in the nose needs same-day care.

q_afterNewTrigger.ask: Did it start after a food, sting or medicine?
q_afterNewTrigger.help:
A new thing eaten, stung or taken.
An allergy can turn serious fast.

q_sneezeTrigger.ask: What seems to set it off?
q_sneezeTrigger.help:
The thing that brings on sneezing.
A clear trigger points to allergy.

q_smellOrTaste.ask: Have you lost smell, taste or both?
q_smellOrTaste.help:
Which sense is affected.
It helps the doctor narrow the cause.

q_noseBlockedNow.ask: Is your nose blocked or runny?
q_noseBlockedNow.help:
A cold or block in the nose.
A blocked nose explains lost smell.

q_appetiteLow.ask: Are you eating much less because of it?
q_appetiteLow.help:
Food has lost its appeal.
Poor eating can cause weight loss.

q_re_halos.ask: Do you see rainbow rings round lights?
q_re_halos.help:
Coloured rings around bright lights.
It can mean high pressure inside the eye.

q_re_light.ask: Does bright light hurt the eye?
q_re_light.help:
Light makes the eye sore.
It can mean the front of the eye is inflamed.

q_re_gunk.ask: Is there sticky yellow or green gunk?
q_re_gunk.help:
Thick gunk that glues the lids.
It helps tell an infection from allergy.

q_lumpInnerCorner.ask: Is there a red, sore lump by the corner of the eye?
q_lumpInnerCorner.help:
A tender swelling beside the nose.
The tear sac may be infected.

q_cannotCloseEye.ask: Can you not close the eye fully?
q_cannotCloseEye.help:
The lid will not shut.
The eye dries and can be damaged.

q_thirstPee.ask: Are you very thirsty, passing lots of urine?
q_thirstPee.help:
Drinking and peeing far more than usual.
High sugar can blur sight.

q_doubleGoesOneClosed.ask: Does it go away if you close one eye?
q_doubleGoesOneClosed.help:
Seeing two goes to one with an eye shut.
Double sight from both eyes can be a nerve or brain cause.

q_eyelidDroop.ask: Is an eyelid drooping, or is one pupil bigger?
q_eyelidDroop.help:
A lid that sags, or unequal pupils.
A nerve may be pressed, or a blood vessel bulging.

q_worseEvening.ask: Is it worse when tired or late in the day?
q_worseEvening.help:
It gets worse through the day.
It can go with a muscle-nerve illness.

q_dryMouthToo.help:
Dry eyes and a dry mouth together.
It can go with a dryness illness.

q_shortSighted.ask: Are you very short-sighted, or had eye surgery?
q_shortSighted.help:
Strong glasses or past eye operation.
These raise the risk of a loose retina.

q_manyFloaters.ask: Did a shower of new dark spots appear?
q_manyFloaters.help:
Many new specks at once.
It can mean the retina is tearing.

q_toothChest.ask: Does it come with effort, chest tightness or sweating?
q_toothChest.help:
Tooth or jaw pain with exertion or chest symptoms.
Heart pain can spread to the jaw and teeth.

q_faceSwollen.ask: Is your face or jaw swollen?
q_faceSwollen.help:
Swelling of the cheek or jaw.
A tooth infection can spread.

q_painWakes.ask: Does it wake you, or linger after hot or cold?
q_painWakes.help:
Pain at night or lasting after a drink.
It shows deep tooth damage.

q_bleedOnlyBrushing.ask: Do gums bleed only when you brush?
q_bleedOnlyBrushing.help:
Bleeding only when cleaning.
This is usually gum inflammation.

q_bleedSpont.ask: Do gums bleed on their own, without brushing?
q_bleedSpont.help:
Bleeding with no touch.
Bleeding on its own can mean a blood problem.

q_tiredPale.ask: Are you very tired and pale?
q_tiredPale.help:
No energy and a pale face.
Low blood count can cause this.

q_gumPus.ask: Is a gum swollen, painful or oozing pus?
q_gumPus.help:
A sore lump on the gum.
It can be a tooth abscess.

q_ulcerNumber.ask: How many ulcers do you have?
q_ulcerNumber.help:
A count of sores in the mouth.
Many ulcers point to a different cause.

q_ulcerHard.ask: Is it hard, or a red or white patch that stays?
q_ulcerHard.help:
A firm lump or a patch that stays.
These can be early mouth cancer.

q_painStopsDrinking.ask: Is it too sore to eat or drink?
q_painStopsDrinking.help:
Pain stops you taking fluids.
Being dry is risky, more so when older.

q_dentureLoose.ask: Do your dentures rock or rub?
q_dentureLoose.help:
Dentures that move or rub the gum.
Rubbing makes sores.

q_sorePatch.ask: Is there a red or raw patch on the gum?
q_sorePatch.help:
A sore spot under the denture.
It helps find where they rub.

q_whitePatch.ask: Are there white patches that wipe off?
q_whitePatch.help:
Creamy patches on gum or tongue.
It can be thrush.

q_wearAtNight.ask: Do you sleep with dentures in?
q_wearAtNight.help:
Wearing dentures overnight.
It raises the chance of sores and thrush.

q_drowsy.ask: Are you unusually sleepy or muddled?
q_drowsy.help:
More sleepy or confused than normal.
Being very dry can do this.

q_cheekSwollen.ask: Is a cheek or under the jaw swollen and sore?
q_cheekSwollen.help:
Swelling near the ear or jaw.
A spit gland may be blocked or infected.

q_onsetWhen.help:
How long you have had this.
Sudden or new problems need faster care.

q_happenedWhen.help:
How long ago it happened.
Some care must start within hours.

q_injuryFirst.ask: Did a fall or knock cause this?
q_injuryFirst.help:
A fall, hit or twist before the pain.
Injuries need different checks.

q_cannotWalk.ask: Can you not stand on it or take 4 steps?
q_cannotWalk.help:
You cannot put weight on it.
This can mean a broken bone.

q_cannotBend.ask: Can you not bend the knee to a right angle?
q_cannotBend.help:
The knee will not bend like a sitting knee.
This can mean a bone or joint injury.

q_boneTender.ask: Does it hurt when you press the bone?
q_boneTender.help:
Pain over the bone, not the soft part.
This helps decide if an X-ray is needed.

q_looksBent.ask: Does it look bent or out of shape?
q_looksBent.help:
The limb or joint has a wrong shape.
This can mean a break or dislocation.

q_boneThrough.ask: Is there an open wound near the break?
q_boneThrough.help:
Skin is open over the injury.
Open breaks get infected and need care now.

q_cannotUse.ask: Can you not use or move it?
q_cannotUse.help:
You cannot move it as usual.
Lost use may mean a break.

q_numbTingle.help:
Loss of feeling or pins and needles.
Nerves or blood flow may be hurt.

q_armNumbWeak.ask: Is an arm or hand numb or weak?
q_armNumbWeak.help:
Loss of feeling or strength in arm or hand.
The nerves in the neck may be pinched.

q_coldPale.ask: Is the limb cold, pale or blue?
q_coldPale.help:
The skin looks white, grey or blue and feels cold.
Blood flow may be cut off.

q_legWeak.ask: Are your legs newly weak or heavy?
q_legWeak.help:
Legs give way or feel hard to lift.
This can mean pressure on the spine nerves.

q_numbGroin.ask: Is it numb around your bottom or private parts?
q_numbGroin.help:
No feeling where you sit on a saddle.
This can mean pressure on spine nerves.

q_bladderBowel.ask: Any new trouble passing or holding urine or stool?
q_bladderBowel.help:
Cannot pass, or leaking without knowing.
This can mean pressure on spine nerves.

q_feverish.ask: Do you have a fever or shivering?
q_feverish.help:
Hot, sweaty or shaking with cold.
Fever can mean infection.

q_weightLoss.ask: Had cancer before, or losing weight without trying?
q_weightLoss.help:
Past cancer, or weight falling with no diet.
Some serious causes show this way.

Thin bones, or steroid tablets for months.

q_chestTight.ask: Any chest pain, tightness or cold sweat?

A heavy or tight chest, or sweating.

q_calfSwollen.ask: Is one leg swollen or is the calf sore?
q_calfSwollen.help:
One leg bigger than the other, or a tender calf.
This can mean a blood clot.

q_clotRisk.ask: Any long trip, operation or bed rest in the last month?
q_clotRisk.help:

q_jointStuck.ask: Can you not move the joint at all?
q_jointStuck.help:
The joint is stuck, even gently.

q_stiffLength.help:
Time until you loosen up.

q_jointSwollen.ask: Are any joints swollen or warm?
q_jointSwollen.help:
Puffy joints such as fingers or wrists.
This helps tell the cause.

q_shoulderHip.ask: Are your shoulders or hips stiff and sore?
q_shoulderHip.help:
Both shoulders or hips ache and feel stiff.
A common cause after age 50.

q_headScalpJaw.ask: New headache, sore scalp or jaw pain when chewing?
q_headScalpJaw.help:
A new kind of headache, or jaw ache on eating.
This can harm eyesight if late.

q_visionLoss.ask: Is your vision blurred, double or lost?
q_visionLoss.help:
Seeing less or seeing double.
Eyesight can be lost if not treated today.

q_atNight.ask: Does it happen mostly at night?
q_atNight.help:
Cramps wake you from sleep.
Night cramps are usually harmless.

q_lowFluids.ask: Are you drinking little, or being sick or loose?

Low fluids or fluid loss.
Low water causes cramps.

q_firstTime.help:
You never had this before.
A first attack needs a doctor's check.

q_nonBlanching.ask: Do spots stay red when you press a glass on them?
q_nonBlanching.help:
Dark red or purple spots that do not fade.
This can mean a serious blood infection.

q_stiffNeckLight.ask: Stiff neck, bad headache or light hurting eyes?
q_stiffNeckLight.help:
Chin will not touch chest, or light hurts.
This can mean infection around the brain.

q_lowUrine.ask: Are you passing little or dark urine?
q_lowUrine.help:
Much less urine, or brown colour.

q_rashNearEye.ask: Is the rash near your eye, forehead or nose tip?
q_rashNearEye.help:
Blisters on the forehead, eyelid or nose.
The eye can be harmed.

q_mouthEyeSores.ask: Any sores in mouth or eyes, or skin peeling?
q_mouthEyeSores.help:
Raw mouth, sore red eyes or sheets of skin lifting.
This can be a severe drug or skin reaction.

q_skinMarks.ask: Can you see any rash or marks?
q_skinMarks.help:
Red, raised or scratched skin.

q_faintDizzy.ask: Do you feel dizzy, faint or very pale?
q_faintDizzy.help:
Light-headed, weak legs or grey face.

q_bellyVomit.help:
Cramps in the belly or being sick.

q_trigger.ask: Did it start soon after food, a sting or medicine?
q_trigger.help:
Within an hour of something new.

q_hasPen.ask: Do you have an adrenaline pen?
q_hasPen.help:
A pen you use for bad allergy.
Having one means past serious reactions.

q_rubbedBurnt.ask: Was it from rubbing, a burn or sun?
q_rubbedBurnt.help:
A clear cause such as a tight shoe.
Blisters with no cause need a check.

q_oneSideBand.ask: Is it a band on one side of the body?
q_oneSideBand.help:
Burning pain and blisters in a stripe.
Early treatment works best.

q_sunArea.help:
The size of the burnt skin.
Large burns make you unwell.

q_woundDischarge.ask: Is there any fluid or pus from it?
q_woundDischarge.help:
Wet or oozing from the wound.
Colour and smell are asked next.

q_woundColour.help:
Colour of what comes out.
Yellow or green can mean infection.

q_woundSmell.help:
An unpleasant smell from the wound.
A bad smell can mean infection.

q_blackSkin.ask: Is any skin black or dead-looking?
q_blackSkin.help:
Black, grey or hard skin on or near it.
Dead skin needs a doctor to remove.

q_sorePhase.help:
The look of the sore spot.
It shows how deep the damage is.

q_moleChange.help:
Tick all that apply.
These changes need a skin check.

q_moleNew.ask: Is the mole new in the last year?
q_moleNew.help:
It was not there a year ago.
New moles in adults get checked.

q_skinCancerBefore.ask: Skin cancer in you or your family?
q_skinCancerBefore.help:
Past skin cancer, or a close relative had it.
This raises the risk.

q_hairPattern.help:
The pattern of hair loss.
Patches and thinning have different causes.

q_scalpSore.ask: Is your scalp red, sore or scaly?
q_scalpSore.help:
Skin on the head looks unwell.
Sore scalp can scar the hair roots.

q_recentStress.ask: Any illness, birth or big stress in 3 months?
q_recentStress.help:
A big event in recent months.
Hair often falls months after.

q_tiredCold.ask: Feeling tired, cold or weight changing?
q_tiredCold.help:
Low energy or always cold.
Thyroid or iron problems cause hair loss.

q_noKnock.ask: Do you get bruises with no knock?
q_noKnock.help:
Bruises that appear by themselves.
This can mean a blood problem.

q_tinyDots.ask: Any tiny red or purple dots on the skin?
q_tinyDots.help:
Pin-head dots that do not fade.
This can mean low platelets.

q_newMedSteroid.ask: Did you start a new medicine lately?
q_newMedSteroid.help:
Such as aspirin, steroids or tablets.
Some medicines cause bruising.

q_stuckOnFloor.ask: Could you not get up by yourself?
q_stuckOnFloor.help:
You needed help or could not rise.
A long lie or a broken hip is possible.

q_longOnFloor.ask: Were you on the floor for over an hour?

A long time lying after the fall.

q_standingDizzy.ask: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
q_standingDizzy.help:
Head spins on rising from a chair.
Low blood pressure causes falls.

q_nearFaint.ask: Did you feel faint or nearly black out?
q_nearFaint.help:
Vision narrows or you almost pass out.
This can come from the heart.

q_heartRacing.ask: Did your heart race, or did your chest hurt?
q_heartRacing.help:
Fast, fluttering or uneven heartbeat.
A heart rhythm problem can cause falls.

q_weakSide.ask: Is your face drooping, arm weak or speech odd?
q_weakSide.help:
One side of face or body is weak.
This can mean a stroke.

q_fallsBefore.ask: Have you fallen before in the last year?
q_fallsBefore.help:
Any other fall in 12 months.
More falls mean a higher risk.

q_vomitedMore.ask: Have you been sick more than once since?
q_vomitedMore.help:
Vomiting two or more times after the knock.
This can mean pressure in the head.

q_seizure.ask: Did you have a fit since the knock?
q_seizure.help:
Shaking or blank staring spell.
This can mean a brain injury.

q_headacheBad.help:
Pain in the head that keeps growing.
This can mean bleeding in the head.

q_weakVision.ask: Any weakness, numbness, odd vision or speech?
q_weakVision.help:
A new change in strength, sight or speech.
This can mean brain injury.

q_clearFluid.ask: Any blood or clear fluid from nose or ear?
q_clearFluid.help:
Watery or bloody drip from nose or ear.
This can mean a skull break.

q_bleedingContinues.ask: Does bleeding go on after 10 minutes of firm pressure?
q_bleedingContinues.help:
It still bleeds after pressing hard for 10 minutes.
This needs a doctor to stop it.

q_cutDeep.ask: Is it deep or gaping, or can you see fat or bone?
q_cutDeep.help:
The edges will not close, or flesh shows.
It may need stitches.

q_dirtInside.ask: Is there dirt, glass or rust in it?
q_dirtInside.help:
Something stuck in the wound.
It raises the chance of infection.

q_tetanusOld.ask: Is your last tetanus jab over 10 years ago, or unsure?
q_tetanusOld.help:
No booster in the last 10 years.
Dirty wounds may need a booster.

q_bleedSite.ask: Where is the blood coming from?
q_bleedSite.help:
The place the blood comes from.
Some places are more dangerous.

q_heavyBleed.ask: Is blood soaking cloth within an hour?
q_heavyBleed.help:
Clothes or towels soaked quickly.
Heavy bleeding can drop blood pressure.

q_burnCause.help:
How the burn happened.
Chemical and electric burns go deeper.

q_burnSite.help:
The part of the body burnt.
Face, hands, feet and private parts need experts.

q_smokeFace.ask: Was there smoke, singed hair or a hoarse voice?
q_smokeFace.help:
Breathed smoke or burnt the face.
The airway can swell shut.

q_coolWater.ask: Did you cool it under cool water for 20 minutes?
q_coolWater.help:
Running water soon after the burn.
Cooling limits how deep it goes.

q_tightLump.ask: Is the swelling growing or feeling tight?
q_tightLump.help:
A hard, growing lump.
Bleeding can build up and press on nerves.

q_swellSite.help:
The body part that is swollen.
The place tells the cause.

q_sprainSite.help:
The joint that was hurt.
Different joints have different checks.

q_boneSite.help:
The body part hurt.
Hip, back, neck and head need urgent care.

q_biteBy.help:
The kind of animal.
Some bites carry rabies or venom.

q_skinBroken.ask: Did the bite break the skin?
q_skinBroken.help:
Teeth went through the skin.
Broken skin can get infected.

q_biteSite.ask: Is it on the face, hand, joint or private part?
q_biteSite.help:
The bite is on a risky spot.
These sites are easily harmed.

q_spreadSwell.ask: Is the swelling bigger than a palm or growing?
q_spreadSwell.help:
Red swelling that keeps spreading.
It can be infection or a big reaction.

q_hivesBody.ask: Any hives or itch away from the sting?
q_hivesBody.help:
Raised itchy patches on other skin.
This can be the start of a serious allergy.

q_coughStrong.help:
A loud, forceful cough.
A strong cough may clear it.

q_cannotSpeak.ask: Can they not speak, cough or breathe?
q_cannotSpeak.help:
No sound, no air.
The airway is blocked.

q_lostResponse.ask: Have they gone floppy or stopped responding?
q_lostResponse.help:
No answer when spoken to.
This is an emergency.

q_stuckFeeling.ask: Does it still feel stuck after it passed?
q_stuckFeeling.help:
Food or object feels stuck in throat.
It may still block or scratch the gullet.

q_legTurned.ask: Is the leg shorter or turned outward?
q_legTurned.help:
The foot points out or the leg looks short.

q_openSore.ask: Any open sore, blister or black skin?
q_openSore.help:
Broken skin on the foot.
Foot sores can turn serious, especially with diabetes.
